column1: # UNMODIFIED, its own suite re-run here: PASS 16/16) over every row this KB publishes as
# Apache-2.0, BSD or ISC, plus the 13 rows ACTION MW returned as NOT-MIT-BODY.
# Channel: raw.githubusercontent.com/<slug>/HEAD/<path>, HTTP code checked on every fetch.
# 64 repositories. 10 paths probed each (LICENSE, LICENSE.txt, LICENSE.md, COPYING,
# README.md, LICENSE-DATA, LICENSE-CONTENT, DATA-LICENSE, LICENSE-docs, LICENSE-CC-BY)
# = 640 requests, 120 returned 200. P1056 was then run over 119 reads (licence file and
# README for each repo that has them).
# LIMB 1 (>=1 further split-scope or restricted row -> NOT-MIT-BODY is a blind spot and
#         the whole licence column needs the pass)
# LIMB 2 (0 -> the shape is MIT-specific and P1056 stays an intake check)
# RESULT: LIMB 2 FIRES. 0 further split-scope rows in 119 reads across 64 repositories.
# The only two SPLIT-SCOPE verdicts are p188's own two instances, both reproduced exactly.
# THE TWO SPLIT-SCOPE ROWS, REPRODUCED. Neither is new; both are p188's.
#   ktwyw/python-for-engineers  LICENSE  1328 B  second=CC BY 4.0  nouns=cheatsheet;dataset;documentation;notebook;teaching material
#   siskinskai/spedlex  README.md  13823 B  second=CC BY 4.0  nouns=docs;schema
#   ktwyw/python-for-engineers ALSO reads as CC-PRESENT via its README ("Code is MIT;
#   teaching materials are CC BY 4.0"), which is the same row through a second channel,
#   not a second row. P1056 checks all three places by design, so this is expected.
# 🔴 A NOISE MECHANISM FOR P1056, NAMED HERE BECAUSE IT WOULD HAVE BECOME WRONG DATA:
#   Bbar0n234/learnflow-ai, README.md 16 863 B -> CC-PRESENT:scope-unstated, CC BY-SA 4.0.
#   The CC reference is THIRD-PARTY DATA ATTRIBUTION, not a grant on this repo's content:
#     "This product includes IP geolocation data by IPinfo, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0."
#   A dependency's attribution notice is shaped exactly like a content-half grant. P1056
#   returns the WEAKER verdict and permissive_body=False, so it does not mis-publish.
#   🟢 Rule: a CC identifier beside a named THIRD PARTY is an attribution, not a scope split.
# THE 13 NOT-MIT-BODY ROWS NOW RESOLVE. p188 warned a NOT-MIT-BODY verdict is "not a clean
# bill". Correct — but the thing it was hiding is not the split-scope shape. It is this:
#  slug                                  file          bytes   what the bytes actually are
#  valentineus/moodle-webhooks           LICENSE.txt   35 200  GPL-3.0 FULL TEXT ("GNU GENERAL
#      PUBLIC LICENSE / Version 3, 29 June 2007"). 🟢 This KB publishes it as "GPL" and is
#      RIGHT; the version can now be published too. 🔴 Its "GNU Affero" token is GPL-3's own
#      section 13 cross-reference, NOT an AGPL grant — do not re-read it as one.
#      portfolio and code-review purposes only. Viewing the source on GitHub is permitted;
#      no other rights are granted." It then negates MIT's verb list item by item (used,
#      copied, modified, merged, published, distributed, sublicensed, sold) while carrying
#      MIT's WARRANTY paragraph verbatim — which is why a vocabulary probe can mistake it
#      for MIT-adjacent. UNUSABLE in any engagement. Gap 421's FIFTH sub-1kB shape and the
#  shmercer/writealizer                  LICENSE           47  🟢 A COMPLETE MIT GRANT, and the
#      47 bytes are correct. DESCRIPTION (1 549 B, HTTP 200) reads "License: MIT + file
#      LICENSE", package writeAlizer v1.7.4. Under R/CRAN convention the grant lives in the
#      manifest and LICENSE carries only the YEAR and COPYRIGHT HOLDER that MIT requires.
#      Independently reproduces p185's finding. 🟢 NEW CHANNEL for this KB: R/CRAN
#      DESCRIPTION "License:", a fifth manifest channel beside package.json, pyproject.toml,
#  MoKangMedical/digital-sage            LICENSE           46  🔴 NOT a grant. The whole file is
#      "MIT License" + "Copyright (c) 2026 MoKangMedical". No permission clause at all.
#      🔵 THE DISTINCTION THAT MATTERS, and both files are ~46 B: a sub-100 B LICENSE naming
#      only YEAR and HOLDER inside an R package is COMPLETE (writealizer); the same size
#      naming a LICENCE and no body is INCOMPLETE (digital-sage). Size does not separate
#      them. The manifest and the packaging convention do.
#  ashutoshrana/haystack-ferpa-filter    LICENSE       12 101  Apache-2.0, confirmed by token.
#  bigdata-ustc/edudata                  LICENSE       11 346  Apache-2.0, confirmed by token.
#  myvipbackup2/china-k12-teacher-skills LICENSE       11 359  Apache-2.0, confirmed by token.
#  ink-waffle/sisu-mcp                   none               0  MIT in package.json only (P971).
#  simon-initiative/lti-example-tool     none               0  MIT in package.json only (P971).
#  crevextech/canvas-lms-mcp             none               0  no licence file, no manifest licence.
#  dmontgomery40/mcp-canvas-lms          none               0  MIT in package.json only (P971).
#  educredentials/ec-issuer              none               0  no licence file, no manifest licence.
# 🔵 So NOT-MIT-BODY is a mixed bag of FOUR unrelated things — full copyleft, a view-only
# reservation, a convention-complete stub, and a bare token — and exactly none of them is
# the split-scope shape p188 feared. The verdict needs splitting, not widening.
# THE FULL SWEEP, 119 reads. verdict/second_licence/nouns as P1056 returned them.
